name: A Productive Morning Routine
instructions: Decide the night before what your first task tomorrow will be -- removing that decision in the morning saves real willpower.
Avoid checking email or social media in your first 20-30 minutes awake; let your own priorities set the day's tone first.
Do one small win early (a short task you can finish quickly) to build momentum for harder work later.
Watch today's short video on how a morning routine can shape the rest of the day.
